headline: Bank of Canada Governor Notes Lower Inflation Forecast Due to Falling Oil Prices
summary: Bank of Canada Governor Tiff Macklem stated that falling global oil prices could cause inflation to end the year below the central bank's previous forecast.
why: Central bank inflation forecasts guide monetary policy decisions, interest rate expectations, and fixed-income market pricing.

impacts.name: Canadian 10-Year Government Bond Yield
impacts.why: Lower inflation expectations typically place downward pressure on bond yields.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A reduction in projected inflation lowers expectations for future policy interest rates, affecting bond yields.
